logger.doc:name: Get American Flights request
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { message: "Get American Flights request", (destination: vars.queryParams.destination) if(vars.queryParams.destination != null) }]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json var whereClause = if(vars.queryParams.destination != null) "WHERE toAirport = '$(vars.queryParams.destination)'" else "" --- "SELECT * FROM american " ++ whereClause

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- payload map (flight) -> { ID: flight.ID, code: (flight.code1 default "") ++ (payload[0].code2 default ""), price: flight.price default 0, departureDate: flight.takeOffDate as Date as String {format: "yyyy/MM/dd"} default "", origin: flight.fromAirport default "", destination: flight.toAirport default "", emptySeats: flight.seatsAvailable default 0, plane: { "type": flight.planeType default "", totalSeats: flight.totalSeats default 0 } }

logger.doc:name: Get American Flights response
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { message: "Get American Flights request", (destination: vars.queryParams.destination) if(vars.queryParams.destination != null), fetchedRecords: sizeOf(payload default []) }]

logger.doc:name: Get American Flight by ID request
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { message: "Get American Flight by ID request", flightId: vars.flightId }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- if(payload == null or isEmpty(payload)) "Flight with ID:$(vars.flightId) was not found" else { ID: payload[0].ID, code: (payload[0].code1 default "") ++ (payload[0].code2 default ""), price: payload[0].price default 0, departureDate: payload[0].takeOffDate as Date as String {format: "yyyy/MM/dd"} default "", origin: payload[0].fromAirport default "", destination: payload[0].toAirport default "", emptySeats: payload[0].seatsAvailable default 0, plane: { "type": payload[0].planeType default "", totalSeats: payload[0].totalSeats default 0 } }

logger.doc:name: Get American Flight by ID success response
